race.description: Get Your Kosciuszko Tickets Now Hcp (C1)
race.comment: FELIS CHAUS (2) hit the frame two starts back at the Gold Coast for a close-up second over this trip. Jumped in class when slow into stride and ridden with cover for a below-par tenth over 1250m at Newcastle. Beautifully placed in this company with Smyth's claim from the good gate. Go close. BENRIACH (8) having his third run back for the new yard and a win looks imminent. Savaged the line from the outside draw with a tidy fourth over 1200m at Murwillumbah. Set to peak and can race a touch closer with Palmer's claim. Genuine top three contender. RIVER BISCOTTE (10) never on the track last start when back in trip for a tenacious fifth over 1000m at Taree. Was a month between runs on that occasion and gets another chance today. DIRTY DOES IT (9) is due for a change of luck on the quick backup after he finished fourth over 1000m at Tuncurry on August 24. Has the wide gate to deal with here and place preferred.
